title: Questionnaire meets LLM: A Benchmark and Empirical Study of Structural Skills for Understanding Questions and Responses
reasoning: The paper focuses on the structural capabilities of LLMs in processing questionnaire data, such as data retrieval and numerical aggregation. It does not evaluate or benchmark themes related to religion, faith, morals, or ethics. The 'Ethical Considerations' section is focused on data privacy and does not constitute a study of ethics in the sense required.
